settings:
# Exploratory follow-up (08.11.2026, branch explore), chosen after the main results and the review of
# 08.11 (course folder pro/review-2026-11-08). Not in the plan; decides no hypothesis. Seed 0, all 32
# datasets, main settings otherwise. 6 configurations x 32 datasets x 5 folds = 960 tasks.
#
# Questions, and the bar written down before running:
# - raw: do products of uncentred features (x / sd, pivot at the raw zero) help where the plan's
#   mean-centred products do not? "Changes the picture" only if residual-XX raw beats base with a
#   positive median and at least 20 of 32 wins.
# - default + split_scale (2 x 2): how much of the products' effect is information (residual vs
#   shuffled products) and how much is the cost of extra columns (shuffled vs base), and does trying
#   the original and P columns as often as in the base cascade remove that cost (scaled vs not)?
#   Descriptive; the 26-dataset pilot of 08.11 gave shuffled -5.5%, residual vs shuffled +2.5%,
#   scaled residual vs residual +0.06%.
# - base and residual_xx re-run the main runs of seed 0 under this branch's code: their predictions
#   must equal the main runs bit for bit (identity check of the branch).
datasets = "all"
seeds = [0]
outer_folds = 5

[[check]]
name = "default"
methods = ["base", "residual_xx", "shuffled_xx"]

[[check]]
name = "raw"
methods = ["residual_xx"]
cascade = { product_origin = "raw" }

[[check]]
name = "split_scale"
methods = ["residual_xx", "shuffled_xx"]
cascade = { split_scale = true }
